prompts.name: post-clock
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup + product-mockup. Create a meticulous high fidelity Chinese design presentation for an EXISTING transparent desktop pet, NOT a new app/site. Single design direction only. Target dimensions 2048 x 1536 landscape. Current date 2026-09-15 Tuesday, mock event today 15:00-16:30 "需求评审", location "成都 602", reminder 14:55. This is explicitly a design proposal, not a screenshot of implemented functionality.

ATTACHED REFERENCES: image 1 existing production pet screenshot: primary strict identity / scene composition reference; image 2 current multi-pose screenshot: strict standing, resting, low-energy anatomy and placement reference; image 3 original props: material and lighting reference only. Use real reference artwork appearance precisely. Preserve the same ivory cream inflatable cow-horse hybrid, chestnut brown mane, orange horns, peach muzzle and cheeks, four hooves only, stitched glossy vinyl seams, gold smile bell, charcoal saddle patch reading "牛马". Preserve the SAME grass footprint, wooden quota sign to the LEFT, cobalt blue leather message bag at RIGHT rear hoof. Bag must stay, not become a clock. Preserve sign with "剩余额度", "68%", "¥204.00 / ¥300.00". Do not redesign pet, change to plush or flat illustration, add limbs, wear new clothes, add props in its hands, or deform the original. Existing animal silhouette, bell, saddle, quotas, blue mailbag stay readable and unobstructed. Original daytime cream / warm wood / cobalt blue palette. Warm upper left lighting, soft lower right contact shadows, slight elevated three-quarter camera matching reference.

Presentation: refined warm white studio sheet with huge generous white space and subtle blue-gray typography. One large hero comprising original pet and ONE small new calendar accessory, and an adjacent independent reminder bubble OUTSIDE the square pet bounds to the right. No big rectangular background under pet. Bubble should be polished restrained cream-white panel, muted blue fine border, rounded corners, soft shadow; show exact Chinese "还有 5 分钟 · 需求评审", "15:00–16:30 · 成都 602", "先把手头这段收个尾。", clear buttons "查看日程" "知道了" and small text action "2 分钟后提醒". Primary action blue filled, others understated. Tiny label "演示日程 · 09.15 周二". Keep text accurate, readable, with clean modern Chinese type.

Secondary at bottom: a generous macro closeup of the new accessory alone showing exquisite materials, and TWO small pose studies showing this SAME accessory position with the standing and resting original pet from reference. This is ONE concept and multiple details of it, not alternatives. Label "物料细节", "站立", "趴下". All invisible hit areas must remain implicit; don't draw boxes or developer annotations. No fake OS chrome. No giant dashboard. No long specification paragraphs. Do not imply implementation has passed. Do not draw persistent hover toolbars; preserve surrounding room for existing hover controls.
CONCEPT NAME: "木牌报时钟". New accessory: a tiny rounded cream enamel / honey wood appointment clock attached by a believable dark brown leather clamp and antique brass rivets to the LOWER LEFT side of the EXISTING wooden quota sign's vertical support post, BELOW all three quota planks. It is no wider than 16% of the pet square and does not protrude into hooves, face, blue mailbag, motto, grass interaction area or main quota values. Its vertical center near y=77% of square; left edge about x=3%. Small warm brass bezel, rounded bone-white dial carrying a very simple blue clock mark, folded cornflower blue reminder flag tucked along the outer left side. Grounding via actual leather attachment to post, absolutely no floating. Cream enamel echoes pet body, wood echoes quota sign, brass echoes neck bell. Prefer readable graphic clock face instead of tiny numbers. The adjacent independent bubble contains actual time. At reminder the tiny blue flag lifts slightly; after acknowledgment flag folds down, clock remains still. Never wobble the pet or quota sign. Macro accessory should show finely controlled enamel speculars, tiny cast seams, believable rivets, subtle woodgrain, clean silhouette visible at 36px. Premium toy prop, absolutely no realism mismatch. Header exact "充气牛马 · 木牌报时钟". Subline "把下一件事，轻轻挂在身边".

CONCEPT NAME: "今日预约票". New accessory: a VERY SMALL wooden ticket clip attached just UNDER the existing wooden quota sign's bottom left edge, down its left side away from the pet. It grips one warm ivory thick paper appointment stub with two round corners and a small embossed blue calendar seal. Stub text only "15:00" on a large readable line, not date numbers. A tiny brown leather hinge and two warm brass studs visibly connect the clip to the actual existing wooden sign board. Stub hangs below quota planks with zero overlap on percentage or yuan. Maximum width 18% of pet square; sits entirely at lower LEFT of quota sign, leaves its main post and ground foreground open for pump/feeding. Keep below the three quota planks, above grass line. No entire extra stand or big board. Paper at reminder unfolds a short blue-backed tab, like a work shift timecard; in idle folded modestly. Most natural integration possible: same honey wood, leather and warm brass already used in pet scene; subtle tactile paper fibers and perforated lower edge, slightly curved cardstock, warm realistic soft shadow onto original post. New asset adds only 1 compact visual item. Do not print event title or mini text on tiny ticket; time is enough. The actual reminder information goes in external bubble. Macro shows bevelled wooden clamp, knurled brass hinge, thick paper with honest thickness and folds. Tiny harmless interaction: flip the stub to blank blue reverse, accompanied by separate text below macro "轻点查看今日安排"; not automatic reading receipt. Header exact "充气牛马 · 今日预约票". Subline "下一场约定，夹在小木牌旁". Reference animal remains identically styled, not enlarged or exaggerated.

An A-frame made of same honey wood as quota sign, two tiny warm brass binder rings, cream thick paper leaf with a cobalt-blue calendar symbol and large "15:00".
